test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Advanced Full Test - 04
subject: general
question:
There are seven students - A, B, C, D, X, Y and Z - sitting in their classroom, facing in the southern direction in such a way that A and D do not sit together. Z sits second to the left of X. B does not sit with Z. X is fourth to the right of C. A and B are not sitting together. C sits in between D and Y. Y sits second to the left of the one who sits second to the left of B.

Who will sit at the extreme ends?
solution:
The arrangement of the students as per the given data:

(1) Z sits second to the left of X and X is fourth to the right of C.

(3) A and D, B and Z, A and B do not sit together and Y sits second to the left of the one who sits second to the left of B.

Here,** B and D** sit at the extreme ends.

Hence, the correct answer is **"B and D".**
